metadata.name: reward_distribution
metadata.description: Solana program to distribute block rewards amongst Rakurai, validator, and stakers. Staker rewards accumulate in a collection account and are distributed post-epoch using a merkle root.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Claims rewards for a staker from the [RewardCollectionAccount] according to their merkle proof.

accounts.name: claim_status
docs: Status of the claim. Used to prevent the same party from claiming multiple times.

accounts.name: claimant
docs: Receiver of the funds.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Fee payer for the claim transaction.

instructions.name: claim_revenue
docs: Claims revenue for a completed epoch.

instructions.name: close_claim_status
docs: Permissionless; can only be invoked once the [`RewardCollectionAccount`] has expired.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

accounts.name: claim_status
docs: The [`ClaimStatus`] account associated with the staker's pubkey is closed in this instruction, returning rent to the original payer (`claim_status_payer`).

accounts.name: claim_status_payer
docs: Account that receives the closed account's lamports.

instructions.name: close_config
docs: Closes the reward distribution config account and reclaims rent.
Only the config authority can invoke this instruction.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings to be closed.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The authority that can close the config account.

instructions.name: close_revenue_share_account
docs: Closes a revenue share account; rent is returned to the original initializer.

instructions.name: close_reward_collection_account
docs: Sends unclaimed funds to the `initializer` and closes the [`RewardCollectionAccount`],
returning rent to the validator.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Sets up the singleton [RewardDistributionConfigAccount] to store global configuration settings for Rakurai.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

accounts.name: initializer
docs: Fee payer for the initialize transaction

instructions.name: initialize_revenue_share_account
docs: Initializes a revenue share vault (tip or backrun) for a validator.

instructions.name: initialize_reward_collection_account
docs: Initialize a new [RewardCollectionAccount] (legacy account list).
Prefer `initialize_reward_collection_account_v1` for enabled RAA validation.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

instructions.name: initialize_reward_collection_account_v1
docs: Initialize a new [RewardCollectionAccount] with Rakurai activation checks.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

instructions.name: record_revenue
docs: Records revenue for the current epoch (accounting only).

instructions.name: transfer_client_commission_on_mev_commission
docs: Deducts client commission from MEV rewards earned by the validator.

instructions.name: transfer_staker_rewards
docs: Transfers staker rewards to the [RewardCollectionAccount] and client commission to commission account from `total_rewards`.
Invoked every leader turn.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Update config fields. Only the [RewardDistributionConfigAccount] authority can invoke this.
Grows legacy config accounts to the current [`RewardDistributionConfigAccount::SIZE`]
(e.g. to persist `revenue_manager_authority`) before applying updates.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

instructions.name: update_epoch_converted_to_block_reward
docs: Marks a claimed epoch ledger entry as `converted_to_block_reward`.
Requires account `convert_to_block_rewards`, entry claimed, and entry flag still false.
Callable by manager, record authority, or validator identity (vote node signer).

instructions.name: update_revenue_share_config
docs: Updates revenue share config (`commission_bps`, `commission_account`, `convert_to_block_rewards`). Manager authority only.

instructions.name: upload_merkle_root
docs: Uploads a merkle root to the [RewardCollectionAccount]. Only the `merkle_root_upload_authority` can invoke this instruction.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

errors.name: AccountValidationFailure
errors.msg: Account failed validation.

errors.name: ArithmeticError
errors.msg: Encountered an arithmetic under/overflow error.

errors.name: ExceedsMaxClaim
errors.msg: The maximum number of funds to be claimed has been exceeded.

errors.name: ExceedsMaxNumNodes
errors.msg: The maximum number of claims has been exceeded.

errors.name: ExpiredRewardCollectionAccount
errors.msg: The given RewardCollectionAccount has expired.

errors.name: FundsAlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: The funds for the given index and RewardCollectionAccount have already been claimed.

errors.name: InvalidProof
errors.msg: The given proof is invalid.

errors.name: MaxCommissionFeeBpsExceeded
errors.msg: Validator's commission basis points must be less than or equal to the RewardDistributionConfigAccount account's max_commission_bps.

errors.name: PrematureCloseRewardCollectionAccount
errors.msg: The given RewardCollectionAccount is not ready to be closed.

errors.name: PrematureCloseClaimStatus
errors.msg: The given ClaimStatus account is not ready to be closed.

errors.name: PrematureMerkleRootUpload
errors.msg: Must wait till at least one epoch after the reward distribution account was created to upload the merkle root.

errors.name: RootNotUploaded
errors.msg: No merkle root has been uploaded to the given RewardCollectionAccount.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized signer.

errors.name: RewardsTooLow
errors.msg: Total rewards must be greater than 0.

errors.name: InvalidClientCommissionAccount
errors.msg: Client commission account must be equal to the RewardCollectionAccount account's client_commission_account.

errors.name: MevCommissionAlreadyDeducted
errors.msg: MEV commission has already been deducted for this epoch

errors.name: InvalidRevenueName
errors.msg: Revenue label must be non-empty.

errors.name: InvalidRevenueEpochCapacity
errors.msg: Revenue ledger capacity must be between 1 and the program cap.

errors.name: EpochEntryNotFound
errors.msg: Epoch entry not found in revenue ledger.

errors.name: EpochAlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: Revenue for this epoch has already been claimed.

errors.name: PrematureRevenueClaim
errors.msg: Revenue can only be claimed after the epoch has ended.

errors.name: ConvertToBlockRewardsNotEnabled
errors.msg: Account convert_to_block_rewards must be enabled.

errors.name: EpochNotClaimed
errors.msg: Revenue for this epoch has not been claimed yet.

errors.name: EpochAlreadyConvertedToBlockReward
errors.msg: Revenue for this epoch is already marked converted to block rewards.

errors.name: RevenueManagerNotConfigured
errors.msg: Tip/backrun revenue manager is not configured on the reward distribution config.

errors.name: RakuraiSchedulerNotEnabled
errors.msg: Rakurai scheduler is not enabled for this validator.

types.name: ClaimStatus
docs: Stores claim status for a given leaf in the Merkle tree.

fields.name: is_claimed
docs: Whether the claim was already made.

fields.name: claimant
docs: Who made the claim.

fields.name: claim_status_payer
docs: Payer of the claim status account.

fields.name: slot_claimed_at
docs: Slot when the claim was made.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount claimed.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Expiry of this claim.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: claim_status_payer
docs: Account where funds were transferred to.

fields.name: claim_status_account
docs: [ClaimStatus] account that was closed.

fields.name: reward_collection_account
docs: [RewardCollectionAccount] claimed from.

fields.name: payer
docs: User that paid for the claim, may or may not be the same as claimant.

fields.name: claimant
docs: Account that received the funds.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount of funds to distribute.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority that closed the config account.

fields.name: lamports_reclaimed
docs: Amount of lamports reclaimed.

fields.name: authority
docs: Who updated it.

types.name: EpochAmountEntry
docs: Per-epoch attributed amount.

fields.name: converted_to_block_reward
docs: When true, this epoch's share is converted to block rewards on claim.

types.name: MerkleRoot
docs: Metadata about the Merkle root used for claims.

fields.name: root
docs: Merkle root hash.

fields.name: max_total_claim
docs: Max total funds claimable.

fields.name: max_num_nodes
docs: Max number of nodes that can claim.

fields.name: total_funds_claimed
docs: Funds already claimed.

fields.name: num_nodes_claimed
docs: Number of nodes that have claimed.

fields.name: merkle_root_upload_authority
docs: Who uploaded the root.

fields.name: reward_collection_account
docs: Where the root was uploaded to.

types.name: MevCommissionTransferredEvent
docs: Emitted when client commission on MEV rewards is transferred.

fields.name: is_enabled
docs: Whether the rakurai scheduler is enabled.

fields.name: proposer
docs: Who proposed this change (optional).

fields.name: validator_authority
docs: Main validator's signing authority.

fields.name: block_reward_commission_bps
docs: Validator commission on Block Rewards in basis points.

fields.name: client_commission_bps
docs: Client commission in basis points.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA.

fields.name: hash
docs: Optional hash.

types.name: RevenueKind
docs: Revenue share vault kind; included in PDA seeds after [`RevenueShareAccount::SEED`].

types.name: RevenueLedger
docs: Per-account epoch revenue ledger; grows until `max_epoch_entries` then overrides oldest epoch.

types.name: RevenueShareAccount
docs: Tip/backrun revenue share vault per validator (accounting + lamport vault).

fields.name: share_kind
docs: Tip vs backrun; part of the PDA seeds with `name` and `validator_vote`.

fields.name: name
docs: UTF-8 padded label (used in PDA seeds).

fields.name: initializer
docs: Who paid to create this account; receives rent on close.

fields.name: manager_authority
docs: Claims revenue, updates config, and closes the account.

fields.name: record_authority
docs: Signs `record_revenue`.

fields.name: max_epoch_entries
docs: Max distinct epochs in `ledger`.

fields.name: commission_bps
docs: Commission on revenue claims (basis points); remainder goes to validator identity.

fields.name: commission_account
docs: Receives the commission portion on claim.

fields.name: convert_to_block_rewards
docs: When true, recorded share is converted to block rewards on claim.

types.name: RewardCollectionAccount
docs: Stores validator reward collection account data for a given epoch.

fields.name: validator_vote_account
docs: Validator's vote account.

fields.name: merkle_root_upload_authority
docs: Authorized uploader of the Merkle root.

fields.name: merkle_root
docs: Optional Merkle root used for claims.

fields.name: creation_epoch
docs: Epoch when account was initialized.

fields.name: block_reward_commission_bps
docs: Commission on Block Rewards taken by validator specified in basis points.

fields.name: client_commission_bps
docs: Commission on block rewards & MEV tips specified in basis points; deducted if enabled.

fields.name: client_commission_account
docs: Account receiving client commission.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Epoch when claims expire.

fields.name: initializer
docs: Who initialized the account (validator identity).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: client_mev_commission_deducted
docs: Amount of MEV commission deducted by Client (if enabled).

fields.name: initializer
docs: Account where unclaimed funds were transferred to.

fields.name: reward_collection_account
docs: [RewardCollectionAccount] closed.

fields.name: expired_amount
docs: Unclaimed amount transferred.

fields.name: reward_collection_account
docs: The newly initialized reward colection account.

types.name: RewardDistributionConfigAccount
docs: Stores configuration for the reward distribution program.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authorized updater of the config.

fields.name: num_epochs_valid
docs: Number of epochs the collection account is valid.

fields.name: max_commission_bps
docs: Max allowed validator commission (basis points).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: client_commission_on_mev_commission_enabled
docs: If enabled, Client will also deduct its commission from the validator’s MEV commission.

fields.name: revenue_manager_authority
docs: Authority that may create tip/backrun revenue share accounts and manage claims. `None` disables revenue share account creation.

types.name: StakerRewardsTransferredEvent
docs: Emitted when staker rewards are transferred after deducting commission.
